alignment.delay_sign_convention: observed[n] ~= gain*reference[n-delay]; positive means PA output lags PA input

feedback_path_correction.dc_offset: not estimated; input data assumed pre-corrected
feedback_path_correction.frequency_response: not estimated; input data assumed pre-equalized
feedback_path_correction.iq_imbalance: not estimated; input data assumed pre-corrected

claims_scope.inverse_metric: postdistorter diagnostic only; not proof of predistorter linearization

spec.description: 5-carrier LTE 20MHz (TM3.1a 256QAM), APA device. Generated at 491.52MHz (SCS=15kHz), transmitted/captured at 983.04MHz (effective SCS=30kHz, BW=200MHz).

target_gain.definition: max(abs(y_train))/max(abs(x_train)); training split only; matches vendor/OpenDPD/utils/util.py set_target_gain

test_evaluation_instruction: Run baseline.evaluate_spline separately. Do not choose a model after inspecting its test result.
